svg.title: Use queue status and logs to follow the work
svg.desc: An agent submits named research commands to pueue. A computer shows a queue with a concurrency limit of two, completed and failed jobs, two running jobs and a waiting job. The saved log for job 32 reports a missing input and a nonzero exit code. The agent investigates before resubmitting. This is a schematic status display.
svg.text: Submit jobs, then inspect their status and logs
The agent diagnoses the failed job before resubmitting it
The queue continues while its computer stays awake
